native_mechanisms: Two symbol-strings laid crosswise over a tray so their crossings mark a lattice of junctions to be scored.

A single one-cell-wide agent walking the eight compass directions, depositing/comparing scores in place, curling back over its own trail to re-test a junction from another face, keeping no ledger but the board, and halting only when no junction anywhere can be improved.
A sideways furrow-crossing that costs nothing, letting one cord slip a step ahead of the other (a free gap/stumble step).
core_technique: Banded Needleman-Wunsch (band half-width derived from the Hamming distance bound g <= 2D/5) computed as an anti-diagonal wavefront with three rolling diagonals and AVX2 32-bit SIMD lanes, with a two-row scalar DP fallback for small n or wide bands.
